hypothesis: Simple unlabeled-action Hamming diversity acquisition can improve cold consequence prediction relative to randomly selected interventions while maintaining old-context accuracy and resource cost on new worlds.
motivation_and_selection_bias: ENERGY-48 energy-disagreement selector failed two excluded exploratory screens (seeds 99913,99919). On those screens, Hamming diversity consistently beat random acquisition. Therefore this candidate was chosen using excluded exploratory data, NOT blind a priori. The fresh primary [9109,9127,9137] is reserved and has never been scored; do not use screen values as confirmatory evidence.

frozen_design.grammar: Exactly 364 authored unary/pair/triple parity and pairwise AND factors on 12 intervention bits; first 10 causal, final 2 nuisance correlation cues; hidden 5 signed factors.
frozen_design.candidate: Unlabeled Hamming-space max-min diversity relative to the initial 48 new-context actions, with stable lowest-index tie breaking, 24 selections, no use of new labels until after pool action indices are committed.
controls: sparse old-new OMP4 factor-energy contradiction disagreement
learners: ElasticNet alpha=0.025,l1_ratio=0.85,max_iter=4000,tol=1e-5,fit_intercept=True, 728 stage-gated authored factors; all arms exactly same labeled examples
OMP7 fit_intercept=True with 7 nonzero coefficients on same 728 factors, all arms
frozen_design.selection_source: All policy choices depend only on the public action pool, 96 old plus 48 fixed new witnesses, never pool labels or held results. Pool labels are produced/revealed by the evaluator AFTER independent choice of 24 indices.
frozen_design.shared_info_and_compute: Every policy learns from the same 96 old + 48 initial new witnesses and receives exactly 24 additional consequence labels, then retrains both downstream predictor families fully. Selection-cost timings measured; bootstrapped committee has extra fitting work charged to it.
frozen_design.evaluation: Per-world old/new/cold held real-valued MSE, 27 changed vs nine unchanged, three independently seeded cohorts; compare identical downstream learner to isolate acquisition value.
frozen_design.timing: Per-arm selection plus downstream ElasticNet fit/predict single-threaded Linux CPU elapsed, excluding common world generation, Python imports and audits. Report empirical costs, no physical Joule efficiency claims.
frozen_design.runtime: Python 3.13.5, NumPy 2.3.5, sklearn 1.8.0, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
frozen_design.run_budget: One primary run 36 worlds, one unmodified-source semantic replay excluding timing, and one independent all-case/full-refit audit. No post-primary changes or additional seeds.

critical.cold_gain_5pct_vs_random: Diversity+ElasticNet mean cold MSE <=0.95*random+ElasticNet mean cold MSE across 36.
critical.seed_wins_2of3_vs_random: Diversity+ElasticNet cold MSE strictly lower than random in >=2 of 3 independently seeded 12-world cohorts.
critical.old_loss_at_most_2pct_vs_best: Diversity old MSE <=1.02*minimum old MSE among all other fully evaluated same-learner selectors.
critical.compute_at_most_1_3x_random: Diversity selection+ElasticNet fit/predict aggregate wall <=1.30 times random same quantity.
critical.nochange_cold_at_most_10pct_vs_random: Nine no-change worlds mean cold MSE <=1.10 times random.

supporting.cold_gain_3pct_vs_best_other: Diversity mean cold MSE <=.97*minimum cold MSE among all six other same-learner selectors.
supporting.changed_cold_gain_5pct_vs_random: 27 changed worlds mean diversity cold MSE <=.95*random.
supporting.shuffled_negative_gain_5pct: Diversity cold mean MSE <=.95*shuffled sparse-consequence selector cold mean MSE.

classification.DEVELOPMENT_PROVISIONAL_GO: All five critical gates PASS and at least two of four supporting gates PASS, and independently authored scorer/source/refit audit PASS. This still does NOT confer SCIENTIFIC_PASS, native Yggdrasil qualification, training-loop integration, or acceptance.
classification.DEVELOPMENT_MIXED: All five critical PASS but fewer than two supporting PASS, independent audit PASS. Preserves limited positive evidence without overpromotion.
classification.DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO: Any critical gate FAIL or invalid independent audit; audit failure specifically INVALID, not a valid scientific negative.
classification.INVALID: Any prereg/source commit ordering mismatch, consumed primary before protocol, changed arm/seed/hyperparameters, hidden pool label or held-data leakage, missing strong baseline, incorrect original-result custody or independent audit mismatch.

audit_requirements: Rebuild all world sources and hidden factors independently; reproduce 7 intervention-choice index lists for every world using only observable inputs; independently train and compare 14 downstream fits per world; verify every 128-sample prediction digest and three MSE. Check source bundle original SHA and same-score deterministic replay. Never treat a code-atlas CI failure as an independent scientific audit failure.
prohibitions: No postscore selection of winning arm or revised threshold
No additional primary runs beyond deterministic replay
No Yggdrasil model native weight write or scientific first-use
No changing accepted/main refs, controller, scheduler, queue, run owner or merge
